raw_findings.body: The global translation accelerator can return the value resolved through the previous tenant's or previous setting's fallback language, so users see text in the wrong language until the cache is cleared or evicted.
raw_findings.failure_mode: A cached fallback result is reused in a different fallback context instead of resolving the key through the current site's locale chain.
raw_findings.impact: The global translation accelerator can return the value resolved through the previous tenant's or previous setting's fallback language, so users see text in the wrong language until the cache is cleared or evicted.
raw_findings.root_cause: Fallback resolution now depends on tenant-scoped mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale`, while the existing cache key only distinguishes the key, active locale, and backend object.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Include the resolved fallback chain, such as `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]`, in the translation cache key, and add a regression test covering different site defaults for the same active locale.
raw_findings.title: Fallback-dependent translations are cached without the site fallback context
raw_findings.trigger: A process serves two multisite tenants with different default locales, or a site's default locale changes, and the same untranslated key is requested without interpolation under the same user locale.

raw_findings.body: Only the active locale is lazily loaded by the translation accelerator, so fallback lookup sees unloaded fallback locales and can emit a missing translation instead of the available fallback text; a cached miss can persist after another path later loads the locale.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Fallbacks are configured globally but their translation files are absent in processes that have not handled a controller request.
raw_findings.impact: Only the active locale is lazily loaded by the translation accelerator, so fallback lookup sees unloaded fallback locales and can emit a missing translation instead of the available fallback text; a cached miss can persist after another path later loads the locale.
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch couples required fallback-file loading to an HTTP controller callback even though I18n is also used by non-controller execution paths.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Load the complete fallback chain in the central translation path before lookup and caching, rather than invoking `ensure_loaded!` only from `ApplicationController#set_locale`; ensure explicit locale translation paths are covered as well.
raw_findings.title: Fallback locale files are only preloaded on controller requests
raw_findings.trigger: A fresh background worker, mailer, rake task, or other non-controller execution path uses a non-English locale and translates a key absent from that locale but present in the site or English fallback locale.

raw_findings.body: The existing test suite can pass while missing keys fail to resolve through user locale, site locale, and English in the intended order, including the non-controller and cross-site failures introduced here.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Automated review does not validate the feature's fallback order, loading requirements, or interaction with the translation cache.
raw_findings.impact: The existing test suite can pass while missing keys fail to resolve through user locale, site locale, and English in the intended order, including the non-controller and cross-site failures introduced here.
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch replaces framework fallback configuration with a custom fallback object and loading mechanism without adding tests for its observable behavior or execution contexts.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add server-side I18n specs that start with unloaded locales and verify user-to-site-to-English resolution, duplicate-locale elimination, non-controller translation, and distinct or changed site default locales.
raw_findings.title: The custom server-side fallback behavior has no regression coverage
raw_findings.trigger: The fallback ordering, lazy-loading integration, cache behavior, or site default handling is changed or exercised in a cold process or multisite configuration.

finding.title: Fallback-dependent translations are cached without the site fallback context
finding.trigger: A process serves two multisite tenants with different default locales, or a site's default locale changes, and the same untranslated key is requested without interpolation under the same user locale.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that translations are cached without fallback context is speculative. The translate_accelerator.rb cache key includes `config.locale` and `config.backend.object_id`. The patch introduces dynamic fallback via `FallbackLocaleList#[]` which queries `SiteSetting.default_locale` at lookup time, not at cache time. The I18n::Backend::Fallbacks module handles fallback resolution during `translate_no_cache`, which is called on cache miss. No evidence that the existing cache mechanism incorrectly caches fallback-resolved values across different site settings.

finding.title: Fallback locale files are only preloaded on controller requests
finding.trigger: A fresh background worker, mailer, rake task, or other non-controller execution path uses a non-English locale and translates a key absent from that locale but present in the site or English fallback locale.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch adds `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` only in `ApplicationController#set_locale` (line 159). The `ensure_loaded!` method loads fallback locale files via `I18n.ensure_loaded!`. Background jobs (app/jobs/base.rb:151) set `I18n.locale` but don't call `ensure_loaded!`. If a job translates a key missing from the active locale but present in a fallback, the fallback locale files may not be loaded, causing missing translations. This is a realistic trigger with concrete impact.
